text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Entrapment!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A scream echoed out. Seeking the Pearl's recurring
bizarre laughter... was the result of an affliction unique to Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Epiglottic entrapment is a type of respiratory disease...
commonly referred to as 'roaring'.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
It is a condition where the tissue folds at the base
of the throat lift up and obstruct the airway.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Obstructing the throat? Which naturally means...

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As I keep running, little by little,
it becomes harder and harder to breathe.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
There will be no hindrance to her daily life. Her laugh
turning raspy should only be temporary as well.
However...
choice_data_list: Will running long distances... become difficult?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: "That is correct. A slight distance limitation will likely remain in effect."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"We could remove it with surgery, but
if we do that, you won't be able to race
for quite a while."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: At least... over half a year.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I see... Distance limitations,
or perhaps over half a year of rest...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Talk about having quite the bombshell
dropped on us. All I can do is laugh."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We made a promise, after all.
That I'd run in the Shuka Sho with Dober, my fellow Pearl Family member.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Dober doesn't know anything yet.
She's dreaming of racing with me...
choice_data_list: You can't let down those expectations, right?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...I don't want to go against them, I really don't.
But...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Running together right now won't gain either of us
anything, will it? That's why..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Good luck, Dober.
Let's meet again someday, somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We aren't so weak that we can't
even run on our own, are we? That's why—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's a turnaround, Trainer!
Let's change our direction.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"I'm crossing the Shuka Sho off our goals.
The path leading from there to the world no longer exists!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Immediate decision required.
In that case, the options are "pushing through" by restricting her distance, or "making a comeback" via surgery, but...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Naturally, it's not as if I haven't thought about it.
The plan for a complete comeback from surgery...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Taking your body into consideration, that would indeed be ideal.
However, in chasing the ideal, there are things that will be lost.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes—it's "time." At least half a year.
Longer if it takes more. If you take time off...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Delivering hope to the people of the world will be delayed.
Many will give up on their dreams...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Even if, years from now, I were to undergo a successful surgery
and achieve great success—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: When that happens—it'll already be too late.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A deep resolve shone in Seeking the Pearl's eyes.
The resolve to face this hardship head-on.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
So――I won't undergo the operation.
This body wasn't made to be sheltered.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's a sacrifice to achieve our goal!
Let's find a way forward while bearing this distance handicap!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And so, our course of action was decided. To continue racing without taking a break. Which means—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's no choice but to redraw the blueprint.
A plan for taking on the world that the current Seeking the Pearl can actually achieve.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAA!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa...
It seems a mile is my limit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through rigorous distance running and thorough testing,
the distances Seeking the Pearl can currently handle have become clear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She used to be an Umamusume who could target middle distances, but now sprint is her best. The reality was that even a mile was pushing her limits.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Okay. As long as I know my aptitudes, there's no problem.
Trainer, where should I head for my next race?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If we're aiming for the world eventually, it has to be GⅠ races. Which means—
choice_data_list: Mile CS is the only choice.
Mile CS is the only choice.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The Mile Championship...
A 1600m race mixed with Senior Class runners...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Right. That's the only GⅠ under a mile left this year.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Very well! Even if my opponents are seasoned
veterans with many experiences, I have no fear!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's take on that challenge and seize it!
A brand-new future!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our new goal: the Mile Championship.
However, I later learned that veterans
weren't the only obstacles standing in our way.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, look!
At this!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"It looks like someone even stronger than a Senior-class
Uma Musume might show up at the Mile CS.
Look, this message that just came in..."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy, Pearl-san! How is your throat feeling?
I've been in top shape latelyâ

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"This autumn, I'll go BANG☆ at a few graded stakes! And then
I'll definitely win the 'Mile Championship'!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Taiki is on an absolute winning streak right now,
and now she's even won a graded race.
She's truly on an unprecedented scale.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "She'll likely head into the Mile CS in peak condition, aiming to claim her very first GⅠ crown."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"This momentum is afraid...
Far more threatening than the senior Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She was a formidable rival, without a doubt. But with only one Mile GⅠ race left this year, there's no running away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A clouded Pearl and a Shuttle that has finally taken flight
meet for the first time. The Mile Championship
looks set to be a grueling race.
